steps.name: Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
steps.channel: EPF i Grievance Management System (EPFiGMS) portal
steps.when_to_use: For issues such as delays in claim settlements, EPF withdrawals, transfer issues, contribution mismatches, or scheme-related grievances.

steps.name: Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
steps.channel: Online web portal, mobile app on Google Play Store, or UMANG app
steps.when_to_use: If dissatisfied with the resolution from the EPFO grievance portal or for central government body grievances.

note: You can track your complaint on EPFiGMS using the registration number provided upon submission. If unsatisfied with the closure, an appeal can be filed on CPGRAMS.
notes: replaced timeline “15 to 30 working days” of “Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)”: its source does not state it
